name: Chemours
outlook:
What Chemours says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: net sales and adjusted EBITDAIn the fourth quarter, the Company expects consolidated Net Sales to decrease in the range of 5% to 10%, sequentially, driven by seasonality in TSS and TT, with consolidated Adjusted EBITDA expected to range between $160 million and $185 million.
  • Full year 2026: net sales and adjusted EBITDAThe Company expects 2026 Net Sales to grow approximately 2% over 2025, with Adjusted EBITDA between $775 million and $800 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 2, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
